summary: KIDZ AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Catalyst Compute LLC, entered into a service agreement with Canopy Wave, Inc. to provide GPU processing services. The agreement involves a 60-month term with aggregate fees of $44,626,944, requiring Catalyst Compute to deploy 256 NVIDIA HGX B300 GPUs. There is no change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situations event; this is a routine commercial contract for services. The filing does not contain any terms indicative of an acquisition, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, or activist campaign. As a standard service order, this falls outside special-situations categories.
